visualLanguage: design_system/public/PUBLIC_UI.md (locked 2026-08-11). The index.html in this directory is the RETIRED v6 Linear mockup and is kept only because ci:mockup-coverage requires a parity.json beside any index.html. It is not the visual target for this route any more. The target is the six closed patterns in PUBLIC_UI.md, built from components/site/v3.
competitiveTarget: Beat Zillow / Redmond-area brokerage homepages. The answer in the first viewport (D11 H1, live inventory count, median list, days to pending, year-overlay median-sale series on the same Instrument, one source trace), a map+list of live homes, six D11 towns as doors, one listing-alert ask.
note: Migrated off the KB register onto the v3 barrel 2026-08-13 (E-HOMES-HOME). E-HOME-HUD (same day) put the market series on the existing level-1 Instrument via chart={homeChart} from buildRegionMedianChart and deleted KbMarketHud.client.tsx (this page was its last mount). KbMarketChart stays on disk for ci:market-chart-honesty. Rhythm: five of the six patterns, no two adjacent alike, chrome exempt. D11 lead + the on-page alert Sheet outrank the four-pattern preference. Order is Instrument level 1 (D11 H1 Homes for Sale in Central Oregon, year overlay of completed monthly median sale prices, in-progress Pacific month dropped), Quiet (D11 lead, no heading), Field (curated sample of 24, count is the region pulse total), Ledger (six D11 towns), HomeAlertSheet (V3Sheet, same capture as KbCommunityAlerts), Quiet (edges), Footer outside main. The opening Instrument's action is PRIMARY: at 390 the chrome CTA sits inside the collapsed menu. Flattening the series is a D9 defect. The chart atom is E-CHART's. The KB-era deletions this migration made: KbHero film split H1 (titleTop/titleBottom), KbExploreTowns, KbCommunities and its autoplay community videos, KbFeatured 9-card grid, KbListingMap 3000-pin region box, KbTicker, KbSell, KbTestimonials, KbTeam, SmoothScrollProvider, KbFooter, KbMarketHud. Orphaned modules deleted with this change: components/site/kb/KbCommunities.client.tsx, components/site/kb/KbTicker.client.tsx. curateFeaturedTiles stays and now feeds the Field.

requiredComponents.name: KbSectionTracker
requiredComponents.section: Page-level analytics, pageType='homepage'. Kept on the KB register deliberately: section tracking is analytics wiring, not visual language, and the barrel ships no equivalent.

requiredComponents.name: V3Instrument
requiredComponents.section: Pattern 1, level 1. D11 H1 'Homes for Sale in Central Oregon', live active count / median list / median days to pending from getRegionPulse, every figure a door, source is the MLS trace not the D11 lead. Ask is primary 'See homes for sale'. Year overlay mounts on this same Instrument via chart={homeChart}. Not a second Instrument.

requiredComponents.name: buildRegionMedianChart
requiredComponents.section: Chart-on-Instrument contract. Year overlay of completed monthly median sale prices (not a flattened polyline). Page drops the in-progress Pacific month with dropInProgressMonth(zonedDateKey) before the builder. Imported from app/housing-market/_v3/market-charts. E-CHART owns the atom.

requiredComponents.name: V3Quiet
requiredComponents.section: Pattern 6, twice. First: D11 lead as prose, no heading, ariaLabel only. Second: community / market / value / team / reviews / our-homes edges.

requiredComponents.name: V3Field
requiredComponents.section: Pattern 2. Curated sample of 24 photographed priced homes (curateFeaturedTiles). Count is the region pulse active total with its own trace. Footnote states the rows are a sample.

requiredComponents.name: V3Ledger
requiredComponents.section: Pattern 3. Six D11 towns from getMarketPulseCitySnapshots. A town with no live median is dropped, not printed as zero.

requiredComponents.name: HomeAlertSheet
requiredComponents.section: Pattern 5, app/_v3/HomeAlertSheet.client.tsx. Same capture as KbCommunityAlerts: submitSearchAlertSignup, email + filters { propertyType: 'A' } + company trap, guest-watch + alert_create. Disclosure: One email per new listing. Unsubscribe any time.

requiredComponents.name: V3Footer
requiredComponents.section: Chrome. V3_FOOTER_COLUMNS. Rendered OUTSIDE <main> so HTML-AAM maps <footer> to contentinfo.

layoutComponents.name: V3Chrome
layoutComponents.note: This page must not remount V3Chrome. ci:kb-shared-shell fails any page that renders <V3Chrome>.

deferredComponents.name: V3Stage
deferredComponents.reason: The homepage's first viewport is the D11 answer, not a dark opening. A Stage would also put this route inside ci:kb-breadcrumb-overlay's dark-hero arm.

deferredComponents.name: V3Breadcrumb
deferredComponents.reason: Homepage is breadcrumb-exempt (scripts/check-breadcrumb.mjs). A Home-only trail is a dead edge.

jsonLd.note: This route never emitted page-level JSON-LD. Layout still emits Organization / WebSite. Meaning unchanged.

dataLayer.getRegionPulse: lib/data/market/getRegionPulse.ts. market_pulse_live, geo_type='region', geo_slug='central-oregon', property_type='A'. Feeds the level-1 Instrument figures and the Field count. Do not substitute getMarketPulse's 7d/closedLast30Days.
dataLayer.getMarketPulseCitySnapshots: lib/data/market/getMarketPulseSnapshot.ts. geo_label IN D11_TOWNS. Feeds the town Ledger.
dataLayer.getListingTiles: lib/data/listings/getListingTiles.ts. status=active, propertyType=A, limit 200. Curated to 24 Field rows.
dataLayer.getPriceHistory: monthly region series for the Instrument chart. dropInProgressMonth(zonedDateKey Pacific YYYY-MM) then buildRegionMedianChart (year overlay). Not a flattened 13-month polyline.
dataLayer.submitSearchAlertSignup: app/actions/search-alert-capture.ts. Bound to HomeAlertSheet. Same action, same payload shape, same field names as KbCommunityAlerts.
dataLayer.note: Every read is a DAL function from @/lib/data (G8). None is wrapped in a swallowing catch. getCitiesForIndex and getCommunitiesForIndex are dropped: towns come from pulse snapshots, community hrefs are the four canonical slugs. getMarketStatsCacheRowForGeo (sale-to-list) was HUD-only and is gone.

sectionOrder: V3Instrument (level 1, D11 H1, year overlay via buildRegionMedianChart)
